items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Tig Chambers used to play with Frankie Dewson, too.

ctx.x: What was, who'd he play with and what'd he play like?
Tig Chambers used to play with, wait, wait, wait. I'm going to tell you who Tig. Tig Chambers used to play with Frankie Dewson, too.
